stories.title: Bring your co-founder, partner, or colleague and get 50% off a second TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is offering a discount where if you buy one ticket to their tech conference in October, you can buy a second ticket at half price.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people planning to attend a tech industry conference — nothing you need to act on unless you're interested in that specific event.

stories.title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
stories.simple_summary: A company called PrismML is making tiny AI programs that can run on smart glasses made by Qualcomm, without needing to send data to big computers elsewhere.
stories.why_it_matters: If you wear smart glasses in the future, they might work better and faster by thinking on their own instead of relying on internet connection.

stories.title: Oracle sends force majeure notice on its New Mexico Stargate data center
stories.simple_summary: Oracle, a big computer company, sent a notice saying it might delay paying for a massive computer facility it's building in New Mexico if it's not finished by 2028.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and industry experts — nothing you need to worry about in your daily life or business.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse Charm looks like a Tamagotchi, but it’s tapping into a much newer trend
stories.simple_summary: Meta made a small AI gadget shaped like a Tamagotchi (a tiny electronic pet toy from the 1990s) that people can wear on their bag as a fashion accessory.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a trendy gadget for younger people — most small-business owners won't need this to run their business.

stories.title: Google Photos ‘Clueless’-inspired virtual closet is now available on Android and iOS
stories.simple_summary: Google Photos added a feature that uses AI to organize pictures of your clothes into a virtual closet, and it now works on both Android and iPhone.
stories.why_it_matters: If you take lots of photos of outfits, this feature can help you see what you own and plan what to wear — it's useful but not essential.

stories.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is hosting a one-day business conference in Boston on November 4 where startup founders can meet investors and experienced business owners.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters only if you're a startup founder looking for investment advice or connections — most small-business owners won't need to attend.

stories.title: ElevenLabs’ CEO on margins, IPO timing, and telling customers they’re talking to a bot
stories.simple_summary: ElevenLabs makes AI voices that answer customer service calls, and its leader said companies should tell customers they're talking to a robot.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business uses an AI voice to answer calls, you should let customers know they're talking to a machine to build trust.

stories.title: Gemini can now call businesses for you so you don’t have to wait on hold
stories.simple_summary: Google is testing a feature on new Pixel phones where an AI assistant can call local businesses for you to make reservations, check inventory, or reschedule appointments without you having to wait on hold.
stories.why_it_matters: In the future, this could save you time by letting AI make routine calls, but right now it's just a test for certain phone owners.

stories.title: Meet the next wave of VCs judging Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is announcing the judges (venture capitalists who fund startups) for their startup competition at their October conference, and people can register by September 25 to save money.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters only if you're a startup founder competing for investment — not relevant to most small-business owners.

stories.title: Google tests letting Gemini call businesses for you
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI assistant Gemini can now make phone calls to businesses for you on Pixel 11 phones if you pay for a subscription.
stories.why_it_matters: Eventually this might save people time on routine calls, but right now it's only available to certain phone users and costs extra.
